press_references.value: ADNOC L&S confirms early delivery of LNG carrier ‘Arada’

product_launches.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services has taken early delivery of the new LNG carrier Arada, the fifth of six newbuild vessels in its fleet expansion program, and the ship has commenced operations.

press_references.value: ADNOC L&S unveils UAE’s first autonomous offshore vessels

product_launches.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services unveiled the UAE’s first autonomous offshore vessels, introducing unmanned/remote-capable craft to support offshore logistics and operations.

press_references.value: Adnoc L&S uses new AI system to slash vessel service time from 3 hours to 45 seconds

product_launches.description: Adnoc Logistics & Services launched an AI-powered smart port system co-developed with Innovez One, cutting vessel service sourcing time from about 3 hours to 45 seconds. Deployed across UAE petroleum ports (Das, Zirku, Mubaraz, Ruwais, Jebel Dhanna), it targets 3,000 hours saved annually, $950,000 in savings by 2028, 20% higher jetty utilisation and 10% better vessel management.

press_references.value: ADNOC L&S takes delivery of first new LNG carrier from China

product_launches.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services has taken delivery of its first newly built LNG carrier, Al Shelila, from Jiangnan Shipyard in China. The vessel has a capacity of 175,000 cubic meters and features new-generation LNG dual-fuel main engines, designed to reduce methane emissions by up to 50% compared to older-generation technology.

product.name: Integrated Logistics
product.description: Offshore and shoreside logistics for energy operations, including transport of personnel, materials, equipment, fuel and water, as well as support-base services, diving support, materials handling and storage.

product.name: Shipping
product.description: Commercial maritime transportation of crude oil, refined products, liquefied natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas and dry bulk cargo using owned, operated and chartered vessels.

product.name: Marine and Onshore Services
product.description: Marine and onshore operational services covering terminal operations, petroleum port operations, maritime traffic management, warehousing, materials handling, bunkering, ship management, commercial pools and spill response.
